# Watzmann Stay

> Two self-catering holiday apartments run directly by the owner in Berchtesgaden, Bavaria, in the Berchtesgaden Alps. Ferienwohnung Watzmann is central and suited to families and groups. Ferienwohnung Auszeit is quiet, on a play street at the edge of the forest, and suited to couples.

## Apartments

- [Ferienwohnung Watzmann](https://www.booking.com/Share-WsU1Cv): central Berchtesgaden, 2 bedrooms, full kitchen, free WiFi, terrace, parking in the underground garage. Rated 8.9 on Booking.com (93 reviews).
- [Ferienwohnung Auszeit](https://www.booking.com/Share-tRmSEZ): quiet street at the edge of the forest, private terrace, free WiFi, private parking space, direct access to hiking trails. Rated 8.4 on Booking.com (44 reviews).

## Practical information

- Check-out is by 10:00.
- Both apartments are non-smoking.
- Quiet hours: 22:00–07:00 at night and 13:00–15:00 at midday.
- Pets are welcome by prior arrangement.
- Only booked guests may stay overnight.
- Nearby: Königssee (about 15 minutes by car), Kehlsteinhaus (about 20 minutes plus shuttle bus), Salzburg (about 30 minutes by car), Berchtesgaden salt mine, Obersalzberg Documentation Centre.
